text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Penggalakan Pelaburan
(Aktiviti Digalakkan dan Keluaran Digalakkan bagi Industri Terplih) 2012.
(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 2 Mac 2012.
Aktiviti digalakkan dan keluaran digalakkan bagi industri terpilih

2. Aktiviti dan keluaran yang disenaraikan dalam Jadual ditentukan sebagai aktiviti
digalakkan dan keluaran digalakkan bagi industri terpilih.
Pembatalan

3. Perintah Penggalakan Pelaburan (Aktiviti Digalakkan dan Keluaran Digalakkan
bagi Industri Terpilih) 2008 [P.U. (A) 458/2008] dibatalkan.

JADUAL
(Perenggan 2)
AKTIVITI DIGALAKKAN DAN KELUARAN DIGALAKKAN BAGI INDUSTRI TERPILIH
Industri Keluaran/Aktiviti
I. Jentera dan peralatan (1) Perkakas mesin
(2) Peralatan pengendalian bahan
(3) Peralatan automasi robotik dan kilang
(4) Modul dan komponen bagi perkakas mesin,
peralatan pengendalian bahan dan
peralatan  automasi robotik dan kilang
II. Jentera dan peralatan khusus (1) Jentera atau peralatan pemprosesan
khusus untuk industri spesifik
(2) Jentera pembungkusan
(3) Modul dan komponen bagi jentera atau
peralatan pemprosesan khusus untuk
industri spesifik dan jentera
pembungkusan
III. Biojisim kelapa sawit Penggunaan biojisim kelapa sawit untuk
mengeluarkan keluaran nilai ditambah
IV. Tenaga boleh baharu Penjanaan tenaga daripada sumber yang
boleh baharu
V. Penjimatan tenaga Penjimatan tenaga

PROMOTION OF INVESTMENTS ACT 1986
PROMOTION OF INVESTMENTS (PROMOTED ACTIVITIES AND PROMOTED PRODUCTS
FOR SELECTED INDUSTRIES) ORDER 2012
IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 4 D of the Promotion of Investments Act
1986 [Act 327], the Minister, with the concurrence of the Minister of Fina nce, makes the
following order:
Citation and commencement
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Promotion of Investments (Promoted
Activities and Promoted Products for Selected Industries) Order 2012.
(2) This Order comes into operation on 2 March 2012.
Promoted activities and promoted products for selected industries
2. The activities and products listed in the Schedule are determined to be promoted
activities and promoted products for selected industries.
Revocation
3. The Promotion of Investmen ts (Promoted Activities and Promoted Products for
Selected Industries) Order 2008 [P.U. (A) 458/2008] is revoked.
